rationale: Builds on the staged reverse-tail recurrence baseline by replacing the old gap/span staging with a compact capped-depth profile: shallower recurrent tail blocks stay weaker through most of training, then smoothly unlock to full recurrence near the end. This keeps shapes compile-stable, removes the now-unused stage-gap/span controls, and targets the recent signal that staged curricula help while capped profiles were close.
title: Late Full-Unlock Reverse-Tail Profile
